a faint hint of smoke on the breeze
the scent of a million spices
the sound of nearby waves crashing against rocks
the smell of rain hanging in the air
the dripping of water falling from the ceiling
the floor is sticky with something unidentifiable
electricity humming quietly in the background
the deafening crash of something breaking
the clicking and whirring of well-oiled clockwork
the floorboards squeak with each step
a roast sizzling on a spit
thunder rumbling outside and rain pattering on the windows
the sickly sweet scent of something rotting
the scent of freshly baked bread
